typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		MEDICAID_ID as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		DOB as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_1 as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_2 as string,
		MEMBER_CITY as string,
		MEMBER_STATE as string,
		MEMBER_ZIP as string,
		PHONE_NUMBER_TYPE as string,
		PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		FACILITY_NAME as string,
		FACILITY_TAX_ID as string,
		FACILITY_NPI as string,
		ADMIT_DT as string,
		DSCHRG_DT as string,
		DISCHRG_DX as string,
		ADMIT_DX as string,
		PLACE_OF_SERVICE as string,
		PLACE_OF_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		PLAN_ID as string,
		PLAN_DESCRIPTION as string,
		PRIMARY_DX as string,
		SECONDARY_DX as string,
		CLAIM_ID as string,
		CLAIM_STATUS as string,
		BEGINNING_DATE_OF_SERVICE as string,
		ENDING_DATE_OF_SERVICE as string,
		CLAIM_SEQ_NO as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select         [SUBSCRIBER_ID]       ,[MEDICAID_ID]       ,[MEMBER_LAST_NAME]       ,[MEMBER_FIRST_NAME]       ,[DOB]       ,[MEMBER_ADDRESS_1]       ,[MEMBER_ADDRESS_2]       ,[MEMBER_CITY]       ,[MEMBER_STATE]       ,[MEMBER_ZIP]       ,[PHONE_NUMBER_TYPE]       ,[PHONE_NUMBER]       ,[FACILITY_NAME]       ,[FACILITY_TAX_ID]       ,[FACILITY_NPI]       ,[ADMIT_DT]       ,[DSCHRG_DT]       ,[DISCHRG_DX]       ,[ADMIT_DX]       ,[PLACE_OF_SERVICE]       ,[PLACE_OF_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION]       ,[BEGINNING_DATE_OF_SERVICE]       ,[ENDING_DATE_OF_SERVICE]       ,[PLAN_ID]       ,[PLAN_DESCRIPTION]       ,[PRIMARY_DX]       ,[SECONDARY_DX]       ,[CLAIM_ID]       ,[CLAIM_SEQ_NO]       ,[CLAIM_STATUS]  from [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[IA_DELTA_DENTAL_RESULT_INT] Order By CLAIM_ID,CLAIM_SEQ_NO',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> IADELTADENTALRESULTINT
IADELTADENTALRESULTINT derive({Copy of SECONDARY_DX} = toString(SECONDARY_DX),
		{Copy of DISCHRG_DX} = toString(DISCHRG_DX),
		{Copy of ADMIT_DX} = toString(ADMIT_DX),
		{Copy of PLAN_DESCRIPTION} = toString(PLAN_DESCRIPTION),
		{Copy of FACILITY_NPI} = toString(FACILITY_NPI),
		{Copy of MEMBER_FIRST_NAME} = toString(MEMBER_FIRST_NAME),
		{Copy of FACILITY_TAX_ID} = toString(FACILITY_TAX_ID),
		{Copy of MEDICAID_ID} = toString(MEDICAID_ID),
		{Copy of FACILITY_NAME} = toString(FACILITY_NAME),
		{Copy of MEMBER_STATE} = toString(MEMBER_STATE),
		{Copy of MEMBER_ZIP} = toString(MEMBER_ZIP),
		{Copy of SUBSCRIBER_ID} = toString(SUBSCRIBER_ID),
		{Copy of PLACE_OF_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION} = toString(PLACE_OF_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION),
		{Copy of BEGINNING_DATE_OF_SERVICE} = toString(BEGINNING_DATE_OF_SERVICE),
		{Copy of PLAN_ID} = toString(PLAN_ID),
		{Copy of CLAIM_ID} = toString(CLAIM_ID),
		{Copy of PHONE_NUMBER} = toString(PHONE_NUMBER),
		{Copy of ADMIT_DT} = toString(ADMIT_DT),
		{Copy of DOB} = toString(DOB),
		{Copy of CLAIM_STATUS} = toString(CLAIM_STATUS),
		{Copy of MEMBER_ADDRESS_2} = toString(MEMBER_ADDRESS_2),
		{Copy of DSCHRG_DT} = toString(DSCHRG_DT),
		{Copy of PHONE_NUMBER_TYPE} = toString(PHONE_NUMBER_TYPE),
		{Copy of MEMBER_ADDRESS_1} = toString(MEMBER_ADDRESS_1),
		{Copy of MEMBER_LAST_NAME} = toString(MEMBER_LAST_NAME),
		{Copy of MEMBER_CITY} = toString(MEMBER_CITY),
		{Copy of PLACE_OF_SERVICE} = toString(PLACE_OF_SERVICE),
		{Copy of ENDING_DATE_OF_SERVICE} = toString(ENDING_DATE_OF_SERVICE),
		{Copy of CLAIM_SEQ_NO} = toString(CLAIM_SEQ_NO),
		{Copy of PRIMARY_DX} = toString(PRIMARY_DX)) ~> DataConversion
